faq.q: Does it save automatically, and where?
faq.a: Yes. Typing triggers a debounced autosave (about 400ms after you stop) to your browser's localStorage under the key toolbox-notes-v2, and a "✓ Saved" indicator confirms it. Notes persist after closing the tab. Because storage is local to that browser, notes don't sync across devices — use Backup/Export to move them.

faq.q: What is checklist mode and how does it work?
faq.a: The Checklist button turns a note into tickable items. It reads lines in Markdown task format — lines like "- [ ] item" (unchecked) and "- [x] item" (checked) — and shows checkboxes you can toggle; other non-empty lines become unchecked items too. You can add new items from a field at the bottom, and the underlying text stays editable in the normal view.

faq.q: How can I get my notes out of the tool?
faq.a: Several ways: Copy a note to clipboard, download the current note as .txt (empty notes are blocked so you don't get a 0-byte file), Backup everything as one JSON file, or Export ZIP which writes each non-empty note as a separate .md or .txt (Markdown-looking notes get .md) plus a README. You can also Import a JSON backup, which replaces all current notes.

faq.q: What organisation features are there for many notes?
faq.a: Notes live in a sidebar with full-text search across titles and content (matches are highlighted). You can pin notes to the top, assign a colour label (red, orange, green, indigo, purple or none), and sort by Recent, Created or A–Z. Built-in templates — meeting notes, daily journal, to-do, study notes, recipe or blank — can be inserted, and you can drag a .txt or .md file onto the drop zone to create a note.
